study_identification_part.si4_title: Brain charts for the human lifespan

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Aggregate multi-study MRI data across the lifespan and fit normative centile trajectories (GAMLSS) to benchmark individual brain morphology and examine developmental milestones and clinical atypicality patterns.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Case–control comparisons of centile scores with permutation testing (10,000 resamples) and FDR correction; multivariate CMD comparisons across diagnostic groups; additional validations include heritability analyses (ABCD, HCP).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Centile scores and CMD reveal significant atypicality patterns across multiple disorders relative to controls; extended phenotypes (CT/SA) show distinct developmental peaks.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Global tissue volume centiles differ from controls in several disorders with FDR-corrected significance; CMD distributions are shifted in AD/MCI/PD and major psychiatric groups; mean cortical thickness peaks at ~1.7 years, surface area and total cerebrum volume peak around 11–12 years; findings robust to QC and batch effects.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Heterogeneity of scanners/protocols and population sampling; not yet achieving precise diagnostic utility; perinatal inclusion and multi-study aggregation introduce residual biases despite modeling.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "Harmonization ... is challenged by methodological and technical heterogeneity ... thus severely limiting the generalizability ..."; "We do not claim to have yet reached the ultimate goal of quantitatively precise diagnosis ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Out-of-sample centile scoring available via brainchart.io and GitHub (brainchart/Lifespan); LOSO and bootstrap support robust external application.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Healthy controls include participants from fetal (115 d.p.c.) to 100 years; models are sex-stratified. When applying ages, fetal scans are effectively near 0 years. Full dataset list is extensive; representative names provided above per guidance.
